verdict.rationale: Pendo documents official SDKs for building against its platform: a mobile SDK and public developer APIs for Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin Forms and Xamarin Maui, plus a JavaScript install snippet and JS/REST track-event paths. Missing for 10: server-side or backend language SDKs, in-depth SDK reference documentation in the evidence, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
